product.olivetti-envision-p75.summary: The Pentium Envision brought PCI expansion to Olivetti’s living-room PC.
product.olivetti-envision-p75.history: Olivetti introduced Envision in 1995 for use with a television in the living room. In December, MCmicrocomputer listed the 635 MB version with an infrared keyboard at 3,390,000 lire before VAT.
product.olivetti-envision-p75.architectu: It could use a television and be controlled from the sofa. The onboard Trident video supports a TV and the console receives signals from the infrared keyboard with a trackball.
product.olivetti-envision-p75.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-envision-p75.limitation: Firmware verification and boot tests are pending.
product.olivetti-envision-p75.service-gu: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 15
product.olivetti-envision-p75.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 3.01.
